thread:
Maya (Support): FYI - customer Acme reported the usage graphs are ~3-4 hours behind for yesterday. SUP-4321. Console shows last datapoint @ 02:00 UTC but we should have up to 06:00.
Jonah (Eng-Analytics): Thanks, Maya. Do we see any ingestion lag in the ETL logs? Can you paste the grafana link?
Maya (Support): grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/usage/usage-overview?orgId=1&from=now-24h to=now — screenshot attached.
Priya (SRE): etl-bot just alerted about a retry storm on the ingestion queue around 02:10 UTC. @etl-bot any details?
etl-bot: HEADLINE: ingestion-queue backoff triggered -> 02:08..02:35 UTC, dropped 14 minute windows, requeued tasks. Job: ingestion.worker.v3, host: worker-7. Recovered at 02:40 UTC.
Jonah (Eng-Analytics): That matches. Looks like the incremental window failed and the incremental processor skipped 02:20..02:35, then replayed which created a backlog. Need a targeted backfill for 02:00-06:00.
Maya (Support): Customer asking for ETA to get the numbers visible. Any quick mitigation?
Priya (SRE): Short term: increase worker parallelism to drain backlog and re-run the partial backfill for the missing windows. I'm going to scale the ingestion fleet x2.
Sam (Oncall): Scaling now: kubectl scale deployment ingestion-worker --replicas=24 -n prod; watching queue depth.
Jonah (Eng-Analytics): While that's draining, run the safe backfill: 
```
cd /srv/analytics/jobs
python backfill.py --tenant acme --start 2025-11-01T02:00:00Z --end 2025-11-01T06:00:00Z --force --dry-run
```
Then remove --dry-run once counts look sane. Backfill will repopulate aggregated metrics.
Maya (Support): Copying repro steps to the ticket so CS can update customer.
Sam (Oncall): Queue depth halved in 7m, retry errors dropping. ETA for visible metrics ~ 45-60m depending on backfill speed.
Jonah (Eng-Analytics): Also checking dashboard queries — if aggregations fail they can show zeros. Quick query to validate raw ingestion: 
```
SELECT count(*) FROM raw_events WHERE tenant='acme' AND ts >= '2025-11-01T02:00:00Z' AND ts < '2025-11-01T06:00:00Z';
```
If raw count >0 and dashboard still stale, it's definitely the aggregation window.
Maya (Support): Noted. I'll tell them 1hr ETA and that we're running a targeted backfill. Ticket SUP-4321 updated. :thumbsup:
Priya (SRE): One more: avoid running full backfill across entire day — that will thrash the cluster. Use the window Jonah suggested.
Jonah (Eng-Analytics): Agreed. I'll monitor backfill job and post status here.
Sam (Oncall): Backfill started (job id backfill-1750245600). Progress: 10% after 8m. Will report every 15m.
Maya (Support): Thanks all — I'll close the loop with Acme once metrics land.
Jonah (Eng-Analytics): 11:30 UTC update: backfill at 75%, panels should start filling as early aggregated shards finish.
Sam (Oncall): 12:00 UTC update: backfill complete, dashboard reflecting data up to 06:00 UTC now. Marking resolved on infra side.
Maya (Support): Customer confirmed they see correct numbers now. Closing SUP-4321. :tada:
